# Schindler et al. 2021, published SQE parameters

`SQE_CCD_gen_parameters.json` is copied byte for byte from Additional file 7 of `schindler2021`
(doi 10.1186/s13321-021-00528-w; `parameters/SQE_CCD_gen_parameters.json` inside
`13321_2021_528_MOESM7_ESM.zip`). The article and its files are CC BY 4.0, O. Schindler, T. Raček,
A. Maršavelski, J. Koča, K. Berka and R. Svobodová.

SHA-256 `7d86d0cfd155b68accdb530d102e97711de1a5efec96c20b63fb00a20a088be7`. It is the input to
`benchmarks/charges/models/schindler_sqe_check.py`; see `schindler_sqe_preregistration.md`.
